string.text: Stepan Gaika came to the Zone as a rookie mechanic and stayed. He has a bench in the village and fixes what the greenhorns carry in.
Something broken? Put it on the bench. I patch up rookie gear and bolt on the simple upgrades.
What can you do for me?
I repair anything you carry, and I fit basic upgrades on common guns and suits. Fancy work, go see the mechanic at the Bar.
